items.t: Camshaft position sensor can melt and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor and add fuse
items.note: Daewoo's US dealers closed, so a shop may charge for this. RepairPal puts the same job on the related Chevrolet Aveo at about $255-$358.

items.t: Timing belt or tensioner fails and bends valves
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner, idlers and water pump
items.note: Based on the related Suzuki Forenza, which RepairPal puts at about $1,500-$1,600. One Leganza owner paid about $1,500 for valve damage after a belt broke.

items.t: Overheating, blown head gasket or coolant in the cylinders
items.note: Based on the related Suzuki Forenza, which RepairPal puts at about $2,200-$3,050. A thermostat or intake gasket costs much less.

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace failed sensor or fuel part
Read codes and replace faulty sensor

items.t: Automatic transmission slips, won't shift or fails
items.job: Replace shift solenoid or rebuild automatic transmission
items.note: A shift solenoid is the low end; a used or rebuilt transmission is the high end.

items.t: Brakes wear quickly and rotors warp
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Brake pedal goes soft or sinks to the floor
items.job: Repair brake leak or replace master cylinder and bleed brakes

items.t: ABS light on or front wheels lock when braking
Headlights cut out or headlight housing overheats
items.job: Repair headlight wiring or replace headlight assembly

items.t: Exhaust or fuel smell inside the car
items.job: Repair exhaust leak or replace muffler

items.t: Car pulls to one side or steering rack fails

items.job: Diagnose no-start and repair sensor wiring
Replace power window motor or regulator

items.t: Seat belts won't retract or lock up
Shifter sticks in Park or shift button breaks
items.job: Repair shift lever button or shift lock
